dashboard.label: SOC - SMB Brute Force Monitor
dashboard.description: Real-time SMB Brute Force detection dashboard | MITRE T1110 | Domain: marvel.local

search.query: index=winserver2019 EventCode=4625 Logon_Type=3 | timechart span=1m count as "Failed Logins"
index=winserver2019 EventCode=4625 Logon_Type=3 | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 10
index=winserver2019 EventCode=4625 Logon_Type=3 | stats count by Account_Name | where Account_Name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | sort -count | head 10

index=winserver2019 EventCode=4625 Logon_Type=3 | bucket _time span=2m | stats count by _time src_ip | eval severity=case( count>=30,"Critical", count>=20,"High", count>=10,"Medium", true(),"Low" ) | timechart span=2m count by severity

index=winserver2019 EventCode=4625 Logon_Type=3 | bucket _time span=2m | stats count values(Account_Name) as targeted_accounts by _time src_ip | where count >= 10 | eval severity=case( count>=30,"Critical", count>=20,"High", count>=10,"Medium" ) | eval mitre="T1110.001 - Password Guessing" | sort -count | table _time src_ip count targeted_accounts severity mitre

index=winserver2019 (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624) Logon_Type=3 | eval outcome=case( EventCode=4625,"Failure", EventCode=4624,"Success" ) | stats count(eval(outcome="Failure")) as failures, count(eval(outcome="Success")) as successes by src_ip Account_Name | where failures>=5 AND successes>=1 | eval severity="CRITICAL - Possible Credential Compromise" | eval mitre="T1110.001" | table src_ip Account_Name failures successes severity mitre | sort -failures
